verdict.rationale: Ente's own self-hosting documentation covers running Ente Auth on your own machine (at `http://<machine-ip>:3003`) and pointing the mobile apps at your server, and Ente states its server is open source. Missing for 10: detailed installation steps and requirements in the evidence pack itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful self-hosted Auth deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Alternatively, if using Ente Auth, get started by adding an account (assuming you are running Ente Auth at `http://<machine-ip>:3003` or `http://localhost:3003`).
Ente's apps and server are open source
